original_test_intent: Verify the BMC secure-update path rejects an otherwise validly structured capsule whose security version is below or revoked by current anti-rollback policy, without modifying active/staged firmware, SVN, trust state or boot health.
original_method: Capture active/staged versions, current SVN/fuse/revocation policy and PFR health; verify owner-built negative capsule identity/signature/hash and its encoded invalid/revoked SVN; isolate SUT and ready recovery; submit exactly once through the approved update path; require the specified pre-activation rejection/task/event; confirm no write/activation/reboot/version/SVN/config change and normal services; preserve raw error and audit evidence.
manual_activity: Owner supplies and approves the SVN-specific negative capsule and recovery; agent may submit one approved attempt and verify rejection/no mutation.
required_inputs: BMC/PFR build, current SVN and revocation/anti-rollback policy
Approved endpoint, expected rejection stage/status/event and timeout
Isolated SUT, stable power, console/golden image/programmer recovery
safety_requirements: Verify target and negative capsule offline before submission
One attempt only with independent recovery and stable power
Do not fabricate or reuse an uncontrolled image, clear logs or retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect pre-state SVN/version/PFR/health and validate supplied manifest
Submit one owner-approved capsule and capture complete task/error/events
Prove active/staged version, SVN, configuration and services unchanged
Do not choose/generate image, accept mutation, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve current policy and exact negative capsule
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `mc info` is useful post-state, but a corrupt image may fail parsing/signature before the SVN check and cannot prove anti-rollback enforcement.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-approved update endpoint once with an authenticated/structured capsule carrying the approved invalid or revoked SVN and collect PFR/update task evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Invalid/revoked SVN rollback attempt and required block remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Construct a negative-test manifest proving all capsule properties except SVN are acceptable, then verify rejection stage and immutable post-state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds policy/SVN provenance, rejection semantics, no-staging proof and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Generic corruption tests parser/signature rejection, not the security-version anti-rollback gate named by the source.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: If the platform accepts or partially stages the image, the negative test becomes a destructive firmware event requiring immediate controlled recovery.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2280 Wistron-HW-00248-V003: approve BMC/PFR build, current security version and revocation/anti-rollback policy; exact authenticated/structured test capsule with lower or revoked SVN, version/signature/hash provenance; expected rejection stage, task/status/error/PFR event and timeout; required proof of no staging/write/activation/reboot/version/SVN/config change; stable power, isolated target and golden/programmer recovery if the image is unexpectedly accepted.

review_improvement: Keeps the SVN anti-rollback goal distinct from generic corrupt-image rejection and makes absence of firmware mutation auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Secure-update validation is layered: format, signature, compatibility and SVN policy can reject at different stages. A random corrupt or merely older image may never reach the SVN comparison and thus cannot prove anti-rollback. The negative capsule must be acceptable through earlier gates but deliberately violate the approved security version/revocation rule. Evidence must show the intended rejection reason and that no staged or active state changed, with recovery ready if enforcement fails.
